text.k01: [shouting] Hey, someone fell in…! …Hold on, I'm coming!
text.k04: [laughs softly] …Geez. Did you fall from the sky? Lady Celestial.
text.k05a: [teasing] Oh? Then what are you? Jumping into a frozen pond dressed like that.
text.k05b: [softly] The Kingdom of the Pale Moon, the White Dew Palace. …The crown prince's garden.
text.k06: [surprised] …Wait, we speak the same language. [chuckles softly] …Well, that makes things easier.
text.k08: [whispers] …I'm Saku. The prince's shadow. In public I don't exist. …So keep it secret.
text.k09: [sighs] I'll hide you somewhere before the prince finds… too late, huh.
text.k10: [teasing] A celestial who fell into the pond, Your Highness. …Probably.
text.j03a: [chuckles] Hoh. You're the first woman ever to say that to me. …I like it.
text.j03b: [firmly] Jin. The crown prince of this realm. …Some call me a tyrant.
text.j04: [annoyed] …You're still soaked. Come here. By the fire.
text.j06: [softly] A hand-warmer. Hold it to your cheek.
text.j07: [whispers] …You were shaking the whole time. …You're safe now. I'm right here.
text.j08: [curious] …Tell me about the heavens. What's in fashion in this 'future' of yours?
text.j09: [firmly] Shion wants to see you. The star terrace. …Come back quickly.
text.s01: [warmly] …Welcome, my guest from the future. I have been expecting you.
text.s02: [softly] I am Shion. I read the stars for this realm. …That you would fall into the pond tonight was written in them too.
text.s04: [softly] Come this way. It is warm beside the incense burner.
text.s05: [warmly] This little one is Gyokuto, the jade rabbit. They say it came from the moon. …Just like you.
text.s06: [playful] …Oh my. Your cheek seems a little warm. Let me cool it.
text.s07: [softly] …The night wind steals warmth quickly. So it is with hearts.
text.s08: [whispers] …The wind from the left is the north wind. …But my voice is warm, isn't it?
text.s10: [curious] …In your time, are the stars still in the same places?
text.s11: [softly] …Saku has come for you. Take care. The shadows are restless tonight.
text.k12: [whispers] …Assassins. Don't move. …Keep your breath quiet too.
text.k15a: [softly] …Of course. Sorry. I said I'd protect you.
text.k16: [softly] …I've always lived in someone's shadow. …But tonight, I want to be beside you.
text.k17: [curious] …Hey. In your world, what do you think a guy like me would be doing?
text.s12: [softly] Just as the stars said. …Your way home has opened.
text.j10: [firmly] …I won't tell you not to go. …But take one thing with you.
text.j11: [whispers] …My hairpin. …Next time you come, I'm not letting you go home.
text.s13: [whispers] …Take my feather. When you look up at the night sky, remember me. …The stars are always in the same place.
text.k19: [whispers] …My mask. …Next time, let's meet not as a shadow, but right beside you.
text.bj_future: [chuckles] Talking to faraway people through a slab in your hand…? The heavens make strange things.
text.bj_food: [firmly] Hungry? …I'll have a meal brought. The best cook in the palace.
text.bj_cold: [annoyed] Still cold? …Come by the fire. Next to me.
text.bj_sleep: [softly] …If you're sleepy, sleep here. I won't let anyone touch you.
text.bj_praise: [smirks] …Naturally. [softly] …But coming from you, it's not bad.
text.bj_name: [firmly] Jin. It means a swift wind. …Remember it.
text.bj_thanks: [chuckles] No need for thanks. You're mine, after all.
text.bj_leave: [annoyed] …You want to go home? [softly] …Until dawn, then. Until then, stay here.
text.bj_yes: [chuckles] Hoh. Then perhaps I'll make it fashionable in this palace too.
text.bj_no: [smirks] What, the heavens are boring too. …Being with me is more fun, right?
text.bj_gen1: [chuckles] …You say strange things. …I don't hate it.
text.bj_gen2: [firmly] …I don't get half of it. But I want to keep hearing your voice.
text.bj_silence: [softly] …Don't go quiet. …No, it's fine. Just the crackle of the charcoal isn't bad either.
text.bs_future: [curious] …Oh. A tool of the future. Can it read the motions of the stars, I wonder?
text.bs_food: [softly] On stargazing nights, osmanthus honey tea. …I'll make you some later.
text.bs_cold: [softly] Are you cold? …Over by the incense. Or perhaps inside my sleeve?
text.bs_sleep: [whispers] …If you're sleepy, go ahead. The stars will watch over your dreams.
text.bs_praise: [chuckles softly] …Heh. You are the one more beautiful than the stars.
text.bs_name: [softly] Shion. The name of a pale purple autumn flower. …They say it also means 'I won't forget you.'
text.bs_thanks: [warmly] You're welcome. …As thanks, stay here a little longer.
text.bs_leave: [softly] …Your way home opens at dawn. Until then, let us count stars.
text.bs_yes: [warmly] …I see. Then you, a thousand years from now, look at the same stars.
text.bs_no: [softly] …You cannot see them? How lonely. …Then see plenty of them tonight.
text.bs_gen1: [chuckles softly] …Fascinating. Your words are more worth reading than any star chart.
text.bs_gen2: [softly] …Heh. I don't understand it all, but I can tell you're enjoying yourself.
text.bs_silence: [softly] …Even without words, the stars speak. …A quiet night.
text.bk_future: [laughs] A smartphone? What's that. …Could you call me with it?
text.bk_food: [teasing] Hungry? …Later I'll swipe you some buns from the kitchen.
text.bk_sleep: [softly] …If you're sleepy, sleep. Keeping watch is my job.
text.bk_praise: [flustered] …Tch, where did that come from. [laughs softly] …Geez, you throw me off.
text.bk_name: [softly] Saku. It means the new moon. …The moon you can't see. Fitting for a shadow, right?
text.bk_thanks: [teasing] Forget the thanks. …In return, listen to me later.
text.bk_leave: [softly] …You want to go home. I'll guard you till dawn. …I'll get you home, I promise.
text.bk_yes: [laughs] Seriously? …Then I'd get by over there too.
text.bk_no: [laughs softly] …Figured. A shadow never stands out, wherever he is.
text.bk_gen2: [teasing] The celestial's words are hard. …Say it again, slowly?
text.pk1: [teasing] Came to fall in the pond again? …This time I'll catch you.
text.pk2: [softly] In the depths of winter, the middle of this pond never freezes. …Right where you fell.
text.pk3: [whispers] …It's freezing. Get under the cloak. …Just for tonight.
text.pj1: [firmly] …The ice on the pond is thin. Don't leave my arm.
text.pj2: [whispers] …I'm glad that what fell from the heavens was you.
text.ps1: [softly] The moon is reflected in the ice. …Two moons, in heaven and on earth.
text.ps2: [whispers] …I will always remember the night you fell here.
text.cj1: [smirks] …You came. Sit. Tonight I'm not letting you go anywhere.
text.cj2: [softly] The dragon on this screen kept me awake with fear when I was a child.
text.cj3: [firmly] I add the charcoal myself. …It's a fire for you.
text.cj4: [curious] …How is the room of a man they call a tyrant? Quieter than you thought, right?
text.cj5: [whispers] …Even when dawn comes, don't forget me. That's an order.
text.ck1: [whispers] …You're not supposed to wander into His Highness's room. …Well, neither am I.
text.ck2: [teasing] His Highness may not look it, but all he talks about is you.
text.cs1: [softly] His Highness's brazier is the warmest in the palace. …I come to warm myself too, sometimes.
text.cs2: [whispers] …You are the first to soften the tyrant's heart.
text.ts1: [warmly] You came to see the stars again.
text.ts2: [softly] I measure the stars' positions with that armillary sphere. …I'd love to compare it with a star chart from your time.
text.ts3: [playful] Gyokuto wants to sit on your lap. …I'm a little jealous.
text.ts4: [whispers] …I'll give you tonight's stars. …Every last one.
text.tj1: [annoyed] …At Shion's, huh. …Don't stray too far from me.
text.tk1: [teasing] The star terrace is high, huh. …Don't fall, Lady Celestial.
text.tk2: [softly] This is where I nap. …Don't tell Lord Shion.
text.rk1: [whispers] …The corridor at night is like my garden. …Follow me.
text.rk2: [softly] The shadow of the seventh pillar. …My usual spot.
text.rk3: [softly] Those far lights are the night guards. …Real ones tonight. Relax.
text.rk4: [whispers] …Hey. In the shadows I can't see your face well. …A bit closer.
text.rj1: [firmly] …The corridor at night is dangerous. Walk behind me.
text.rj2: [whispers] …On nights Saku can't protect you, I will.
text.rs1: [softly] The moonlight is drawing stripes between the pillars.
text.rs2: [whispers] …On restless nights, stay by me. …I'll protect your star.
text.dj1: [softly] …Dawn, huh. …The sunrise with you isn't bad.
text.ds1: [softly] The stars fade and morning comes. …But even unseen, they are still there.
text.dk1: [softly] …Morning. Shadow time is over. …A little lonely.
text.tt1: [teasing] Hey, His Highness and Lord Shion are both here.
text.tt2: [softly] Before you go, shall we talk a little?
text.tt3: [firmly] …If there's something you want to say, say it now.
text.tt4: [warmly] Please stay well, in your world too.
text.bk_p_pond: [softly] The ice melts by morning. …The hole you came through will be gone too.
text.bj_p_pond: [firmly] Never walk on the ice again. …Next time, I'll carry you across.
text.bs_p_pond: [softly] Cold water reflects starlight most beautifully.
text.bj_p_room: [firmly] Snowy wind from the lattice window on the left, the charcoal fire on the right. …Beside me is the warmest.
text.bk_p_room: [whispers] You'll get scolded for warming yourself at His Highness's brazier. …I always sneak it though.
text.bs_p_room: [softly] Sandalwood is mixed into the charcoal. …His Highness is particular about scents, despite appearances.
text.bs_p_stars: [softly] The north wind on the left, the incense on the right. …This terrace is the border between cold and warm.
text.bj_p_stars: [annoyed] Leave the stars to Shion. …You look at me.
text.bk_p_stars: [laughs softly] Did you wish on that shooting star? …I already did.
text.bk_p_hall: [whispers] When you see torchlight, get into a pillar's shadow. …Just remember that.
text.bj_p_hall: [firmly] I'll deal with every assassin in the corridors. …You don't have to see any of it.
text.bs_p_hall: [softly] Walk through the moon's stripes and you cast two shadows. …One of them might be Saku.
text.bj_p_dawn: [softly] When the sun rises, your way home opens. …Tch, I resent the sun.
text.bs_p_dawn: [softly] The ring in the pond shines in the morning light. …The star gate.
text.bk_p_dawn: [softly] The morning air's cold. …But the sun is warm.
